title: AdriBioPro2026 – Conference Highlights
excerpt: A visual journey through AdriBioPro2026, capturing four days of science, dialogue and cooperation for Adriatic biodiversity protection and sustainable blue growth.
body:
This promotional video captures highlights from the Fourth International Conference on Adriatic Biodiversity Protection—AdriBioPro2026, held from 22 to 25 September 2026 in Kotor, Montenegro.

Featuring footage from across the conference programme, the video brings together moments from scientific sessions, plenary lectures, poster presentations, networking, side events and study visits at the Institute of Marine Biology and Hyatt Regency Kotor Bay.

The conference connected scientists, policymakers, stakeholders and industry representatives to explore marine biodiversity conservation, fisheries and aquaculture, pollution and climate resilience, marine monitoring technologies, and public awareness.

Presented without on-screen text, the video offers a visual record of the people, places and exchanges that shaped four days of regional cooperation for a resilient Adriatic Sea.
